headline: OpenTable Agrees to Acquire Australian Restaurant Tech Firm me&u
summary: Restaurant reservation network OpenTable entered into an agreement to acquire Australian AI-native hospitality software developer me&u to expand enterprise venue tools.
why: OpenTable, owned by Booking Holdings, relies on technology acquisitions to widen digital booking and payment systems across international market networks.

impacts.name: Booking Holdings
impacts.why: Acquiring me&u expands OpenTable's hospitality software presence in Australia.
